title: Scoring text with word counts
description: You can follow a small multinomial Naive Bayes classifier from counts to predictions.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You build a shared vocabulary and count documents and words by class. The four documents use labels 1 and 0.
Laplace smoothing adds alpha to each word count. You divide by the class token total plus alpha times the vocabulary size.
log_score begins with the class log prior and adds each token's log likelihood. You return the label with the largest score alongside the scores themselves.

steps.question: Which label has the larger recorded score for team win goal?
steps.answer: Label 1 has the larger score compared with label 0.

steps.description: You see label 1 for team win goal and label 0 for policy debate. The output includes both class scores for each supplied text.
